subject: Dragon
text: The Dragon boss in Dragon Cave Room #26 is hit on its head by jumping and firing in midair.

evidence.quote: ROOM #26: BOSS: Dragon ... It took me forever to figure out that you have to hit his head by jumping up and firing in midair.

subject: Dragon
text: Waiting for the Dragon to breathe fire is too slow because the spikes fill the room before it can be defeated.

evidence.quote:
Don't 
wait for him to breathe fire as this will take too long as the 
spikes start to fill up the room.

subject: Medicine
text: Room #17 contains a medicine in the upper west corner.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17: ... There is also a medicine in the 
upper west corner of the room.

subject: Four Hearts
text: Room #16 has two sets of tiles that reveal two sets of four hearts.

evidence.quote: ROOM #16: ... Just two sets of tiles which will reveal two sets of four hearts if you need them.

subject: Four Hearts
text: Room #23 has a tile that gives four hearts when activated, after defeating the four rock guys.

evidence.quote: ROOM #23: ... You can also activate one of the tiles to get four hearts.

subject: Medicine

evidence.quote:
ROOM #25: ... Grab the 
medicine as well.

subject: Medicine
text: Room #20 has a medicine surrounded by flames, revealed by jumping on the correct tile to make a question mark appear, which opens the east wall.

evidence.quote: ROOM #20: ... In the center of the room are tiles but be careful as there are flames that surround the medicine and question mark you can make appear by jumping on the correct tile.

subject: Question mark tile
text: In Room #20, jumping on the correct tile makes a question mark appear, which opens the wall to the East to Room #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20: ... The question mark will open the wall to the East and 
ROOM #21.

subject: Spike Balls
text: Room #21 has spike balls in the corner.

evidence.quote: ROOM #21: There are six bats in this room and some spike balls in the corner.

subject: Triceratops
text: Room #17 has a triceratops that must be defeated to open the East door back to Room #16.

evidence.quote: ROOM #17: There is a triceratops in this room that you must defeat to open the East door back to ROOM #16.

subject: Triceratops
text: Room #18 has two triceratops that must both be defeated to open the West door and Room #20.

evidence.quote: ROOM #18: This room has two triceratops. Defeat both of them to open the door to the West and ROOM #20.

subject: Skull heads
text: Room #19 has two skull heads on a raised section that must be defeated to open the West door to Room #22.

evidence.quote: ROOM #19: This room has two skull heads up on a raised section of the room. Defeat them to open the door to the West and ROOM #22.

subject: Armored Knight
text: Room #22 has two armored knights that must be defeated to open the West wall to Room #23.

evidence.quote: ROOM #22: There are two armored knights in this room. Defeat them to open the wall to the West and ROOM #23.

subject: Rock Guy
text: Room #23 has four rock guys that must all be defeated to open the West wall to Room #24.

evidence.quote: ROOM #23: There are four rock guys in this room as well as four patches of tiles. Defeat all the rock guys to open the wall to the West and ROOM #24.

subject: Armored Knight
text: Room #24 has one armored knight and two regular knights that must all be defeated to open the North wall to Room #25.

evidence.quote: ROOM #24: There is one armored knight and two regular knights in this room. Defeat all of them to open the wall to the North and ROOM #25.

subject: Big green blob
text: Room #25 has two big green blobs that must be defeated to open the North door to Room #26.

evidence.quote: ROOM #25: There are two big green blobs in this room and a medicine. Defeat the blobs to open the door to the North and ROOM #26.

subject: Dragon Cave Room #27
text: Room #27 has an exit to the North back to the overworld.

evidence.quote: ROOm #27: Take the exit to the North back to the overworld.

subject: Dragon Cave Room #26
text: Defeating the Dragon in Room #26 opens the door to the East leading to Room #27.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #26: BOSS: Dragon ... Defeat him to open the door to 
the East and ROOM #27.

subject: Coracola Cave Room #1
text: Room #1 has a passage to the North leading to Room #2.

evidence.quote: Take the passage to the North to ROOM #2.

subject: Pink blob
text: Room #2 has three pink blobs that must be defeated to open the North passage to Room #3.

evidence.quote:
There are three pink blobs in this room. Defeat them to open the 
passageway to the North and ROOM #3.

subject: Four Hearts
text: Room #2 has two sets of four hearts.

evidence.quote:
There are also two sets of 
four hearts in this room.

subject: Pink blob
text: Room #3 has six pink blobs, and only one specific random blob must be defeated to open the North door to Room #4.

evidence.quote:
There are six pink blobs in this room. You only need to defeat a 
certain random blob to open the door to the North and ROOM #4.

subject: Floor tile
text: In Room #4, activating the tile opens the door to the North leading to Room #5.

evidence.quote: Activate the tile to open the door to the North and ROOM #5.

subject: Purple bat
text: Room #5 has two purple bats and three blue rats that must be defeated to open the North door to Room #6.

evidence.quote:
There are two purple bats and three blue rats in this room. Defeat 
them to open the door to the North and ROOM #6.

subject: Four Hearts
text: Activating the tiles in Room #6 gives four hearts and opens the North door to Room #7.

evidence.quote:
Activate the tiles in this room to get four hearts and to open the door to the 
North and ROOM #7.

subject: Purple asp
text: Room #7 has two purple asps and two pink blobs in the room.

evidence.quote: There are two purple asps and two pink blobs in this room.

subject: Floor tile
text: One of two tiles in Room #7 opens the North door to Room #9; the other opens the East wall to Room #8.

evidence.quote:
There are also two tiles in this room that open the door to the North and 
ROOM #9 and the other opens the wall to the East and ROOm #8.

subject: Medicine
text: Room #8 contains a medicine.

evidence.quote:
There is a medicine in this room and a tile that opens the wall to 
the North and ROOM #9

subject: Floor tile
text: A tile in Room #8 opens the wall to the North leading to Room #9.

evidence.quote:
There is a medicine in this room and a tile that opens the wall to 
the North and ROOM #9

subject: Two Hearts
text: Room #9 has an island with two hearts.

evidence.quote:
This room has an island in the middle of the room with two hearts, 
a medicine, and a random life sign.

subject: Medicine
text: Room #9 has a medicine on the island.

evidence.quote:
This room has an island in the middle of the room with two hearts, 
a medicine, and a random life sign.

subject: Random-Life Sign
text: Room #9 has a random life sign on the island.

evidence.quote:
This room has an island in the middle of the room with two hearts, 
a medicine, and a random life sign.

subject: Coracola Cave Room #9
text: In Room #9, the island must be reached by jumping to it and back while avoiding as much damage as possible.

evidence.quote:
Avoid taking as much damage as 
possible jumping to this island and jumping back.

subject: Bat
text: Room #10 has three bats and two asps that must be defeated quickly to open the North door to Room #11.

evidence.quote: ROOM #10: This room has three bats and two asps. Defeat them quickly to open the door to the North and ROOM #11.

subject: C-Serpent
text: The C-Serpent boss in Room #11 is defeated by avoiding shots and hitting its head when the mouth is open; defeating it creates a platform leading North to Room #12.

evidence.quote:
[12]-[13]-[14]-[15]-[19] ... ROOM #11: BOSS: C-Serpent ... Just avoid the shots and hit the head when the mouth is 
open.

subject: Coracola Cave Room #11
text: Defeating the C-Serpent creates a platform that allows proceeding North to Room #12.

evidence.quote:
When you defeat it a platform will appear allowing you to 
proceed forward North to ROOM #12.

subject: Coracola Cave Room #13
text: Room #13 has tiles forming an arrow leading to one of three conveyor belt paths to Room #14.

evidence.quote: ROOM #13: This room has a bunch of tiles forming an arrow that leads to one of three conveyor belt paths. Take any one of these to ROOM #14.

subject: Coracola Cave Room #19
text: Entering Room #19 makes you fall through the floor to Room #20.

evidence.quote: ROOM #19: As soon as you enter this room you fall through the floor to ROOM #20.

subject: Floor tile
text: A tile in the middle of greyscale Room #20 appears and opens the North door to Room #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20 ... Eventually a tile in the middle of the room will appear and allow 
the door to the North to open to ROOM #21.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Yum Yum in Room #21 is defeated using the same technique as the earlier encounter, opening the East door to Room #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21: BOSS: Yum Yum ... Use the same technique that you used last time to 
defeat him and open the door to the East and ROOM #22.

subject: Scorpion
text: The Scorpion boss in Room #22 must be defeated while avoiding the small scorpions, opening the North door to Room #23.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22: BOSS: Scorpion ... Just avoid the little 
scorpions and you should have no trouble defeating him which opens 
the door to the North and ROOM #23.

subject: Pharoah
text: The Pharoah boss in Room #23 is defeated while avoiding its blasts; defeating it drops you through the floor to Room #24.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #23: BOSS: Pharoah ... Defeat him while avoiding 
his blasts to fall through the floor to ROOM #24.

subject: Zoda-X
text: Zoda-X in Room #24 is fought on a random conveyor belt; avoid getting hit to defeat him and open the North door to Room #25.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24: BOSS: Zoda-X ... Try to avoid getting hit and defeat him to open the door to the 
North and ROOM #25.

subject: Skeleton Miner
text: The Skeleton Miner in Room #25 is defeated the same way as in the earlier encounter, opening the North door to Room #26.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #25: BOSS: Skeleton Miner ... Defeat him the same way you 
beat him last time to open the door to the North and ROOM #26.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Zoda-Y in Room #26 transforms into a bird halfway through the battle; defeating him drops you through the floor to Room #27.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #26: BOSS: Zoda-Y ... Zoda-Y will transform into a bird halfway 
thorough the battle. Defeat him to fall through the floor to 
ROOM #27.

subject: Dragon
text: The Dragon in Room #27 is defeated by hitting its head by jumping in the air; defeating it opens the East door to Room #28.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #27: BOSS: Dragon ... Just remember to hit his head by 
jumping in the air. Defeat him to open the door to the East 
and ROOM #28.

subject: Pill
text: A tile in Room #28 makes a pill appear.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #28: ... One 
will make a pill appear.

subject: Floor tile
text: The second tile in Room #28 opens the North door to Room #29.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #28: ... The other will open the door to the North 
and ROOM #29.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Zoda-Z in Room #29 starts as four Zoda balls; shoot the off-color ball, then defeat both the true form and the final form to open the West door to Room #30.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #29: ... Shoot at the off color ball until it is defeated and Zoda-Z 
appears. After several shots he will transform into his true form.
After several more shots he will move into his final form. Defeat 
both forms to open the door to the West and ROOM #30.

subject: Flute
text: The Flute is found and used in the Egyptian Pyramid to make asps visible.

evidence.quote: Flute: Found and used in Egyptian Pyramid. Makes asps visible.

subject: Chisel
text: Mike uses the Chisel to get Leonardo Da Vinci free.

evidence.quote: Chisel: Mike uses this to get Leonardo Da Vinci free.

subject: Tetrad
text: Tetrads are found at the end of each chapter and should all be collected.

evidence.quote: Tetrad: These are found at the end of each chapter. Collect them all.

subject: Gold Nugget
text: Gold Nuggets can be sold to Bob in town for points in the Old West.

evidence.quote: Gold Nugget: Can be sold in town to Bob for points in Old West.

subject: Dynamite
text: Dynamite is used to blow open caves in the side of mountains in the Old West.

evidence.quote: Dynamite: Used to blow open caves in the side of mountains in Old West.

subject: Big Heart
text: A Big Heart increases Mike's number of hearts by one permanently.

evidence.quote: Big Heart: Mike's number of hearts increased by one permanently.

subject: Star
text: Collecting 5 Stars in a dungeon restores health by one.

evidence.quote: Star: When you get 5 of these in a dungeon you restore health by one.

subject: Pill
text: A Pill gives Mike a full twenty hearts.

evidence.quote: Pill: This will give Mike a full twenty hearts.

subject: Chicken Nuggets
text: Chicken Nuggets are found in Old West caves and restore health to Mike.

evidence.quote: Chicken Nuggets: Found in Old West caves. Restores health to Mike.

subject: Medicine
text: Medicine restores five of Mike's health.

evidence.quote: Medicine: Mike's health restored by five.

subject: Axes
text: Axes are obtained from a caveman named Tink in the Ice Age chapter.

evidence.quote: Axes: You get these from a cave man named Tink in the Ice Age Chapter.

subject: Daggers
text: Daggers are given by Cleopatra in the Egypt chapter as an upgrade to the axes.

evidence.quote: Daggers: An upgrade to your axes, given by Cleopatra in Egypt Chapter.

subject: Katana
text: The Katana is given by Leonardo Da Vinci in Venice as an upgrade to the daggers.

evidence.quote: Katana: An upgrade to your daggers, given by Leonardo Da Vinci in Venice.

subject: Psychic Shockwave
text: A monkey in the Egyptian Savannah teaches Mike the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: Psychic Shockwave: A monkey in an Egyptian Savannah teaches this to you.

subject: Super Psychic Shockwave
text: A donkey in the Wild West teaches Mike the Super Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: Super Psychic Shockwave: A donkey in the Wild West teaches this to you.

subject: Ultra Psychic Shockwave
text: Merlin in Camelot teaches Mike the Ultra Psychic Shockwave, which requires at least 10 hearts.

evidence.quote:
Ultra Psychic Shockwave: Merlin in Camelot teaches this to you. You will 
need at least 10 hearts to have this ability.

subject: Rocks
text: Rocks are the first weapon in the game, very weak, and found in the Ice Age.

evidence.quote:
Rocks: The first weapon in the game. Very weak but useful. Found in Ice 
Age.

subject: Slingshot
text: The Slingshot is first found in Egypt and is more powerful than rocks.

evidence.quote: The slingshot is first found in Egypt.

subject: Spiked Frisbees
text: Spiked Frisbees are found in Scotland Yard and shoot short-range frisbees.

evidence.quote:
Spiked Frisbees: Shoots little frisbees a short distance. Found in 
Scotland Yard.

subject: Stars
text: Stars are first found in the Old West and inflict good damage when shot.

evidence.quote:
Stars: Shoot these to inflict good damage. These are first found in Old 
West.

subject: Spike Balls
text: Spike Balls fire a three-direction spread shot and are first found in Transylvania.

evidence.quote:
Spike Balls: These do a spread shot in three directions. These are first
found in Transylvania.

subject: Pyramid Guard
text: Pyramid Guards are immune to daggers and must be defeated with the Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
They are slow but are immune to daggers. You need to 
use your psychic shockwave to defeat them.

subject: Porcupine
text: Porcupines are invincible while rolled into a ball and must be attacked when not rolled up.

evidence.quote:
These creatures are invicible once they have rolled into a 
ball. You must attack them when they are not rolled into a ball.

subject: Aman-Ra Guardian
text: Aman-Ra Guardians are moderately difficult, walk slowly, and every so often flash and shoot two fireballs.

evidence.quote:
They just slowly 
walk around and every once in awhile flash and shoot two fireballs.

subject: Owl
text: Owls are always airborne and must be attacked from a column or by jumping.

evidence.quote:
Owls are always airborn so either attack 
them from a cloumn or jump and attack them.

subject: Blue Blob
text: Blue Blobs jump in the air, so they are usually only hittable when they fall back to the ground.

evidence.quote:
they jump in the air and 
you will generally only be able to hit them only when they fall back to 
the ground.

subject: Boar
text: Boars take two hits with stones and one hit once the axe is found.

evidence.quote:
When you first meet them you have stones 
and they require to hits, but once you find the axe they can be taken 
out in one hit.

subject: Scorpion
text: Scorpions are average enemies in Egypt and require two shots.

evidence.quote: Average enemeny you meet in Egypt. Just requires two shots.

subject: Ladybug
text: Ladybugs are defeated by a couple of shots from the dagger.

evidence.quote:
a couple of shots from your dagger and they will be 
toast.

subject: Hippopotamus
text: Hippopotamuses hide in water and fire two shots after popping their heads up.

evidence.quote: They will pop their head up and fire two shots at you.

subject: Cyclops
text: Cyclops carry daggers and are defeated after a couple of axe shots.

evidence.quote:
A 
couple shots of the axe they will be no more.

subject: Dragon Cave Room #21
text: Room #21 contains six bats, which can be defeated optionally, and spike balls in the corner.

evidence.quote: ROOM #21: There are six bats in this room and some spike balls in the corner.

subject: Dragon Cave Room #18
text: A tile in Room #18 opens the room to the North leading to Room #19.

evidence.quote: ROOM #18: ... There is also a tile in this room that will open the room to the North and ROOM #19.

subject: Hearts and Medicines
text: The conveyor belt rooms of Coracola Cave have hearts and medicines to collect while avoiding spikes.

evidence.quote:
Move along 
them collecting hearts and medicines. Try to avoid hitting any 
spikes.
